summary: Well‑executed, preregistered paired study evaluating a verifier‑grounded generate–verify–repair (GVR) pipeline for intent→configuration NetOps tasks in a Mininet emulation (N=200 paired intents). Execution and archived artifacts appear consistent with the preregistration. The preregistered confirmatory test (exact McNemar two‑sided) did not reject (p = 0.125). The manuscript correctly documents shared_initial_candidate semantics, sampling caveats (temperature = null), and limitations. Reproducibility artifacts and the immutable master prompt locator + SHA‑256 are present. Two manuscript corrections are required before finalisation (references formatting and a concise Disclosure Statement).
critical_issues: References section appears to rely on identifier entries (DOIs/IDs) rather than a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography with full bibliographic metadata; the manuscript must contain a standard IEEE formatted References section so each numbered citation in text resolves to full author/title/venue/year metadata and supports the proximate claim.

Disclosure Statement duplicates detailed execution/accounting logs and lengthy provenance material; the track requires a concise Disclosure Statement that includes the single mandatory immutable master‑prompt locator + SHA‑256 and the required high‑level autonomy/provenance items but must not reproduce execution logs or act as a second Methods/Results section.
required_revisions: Replace any DOI/identifier‑only reference entries with a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography containing full bibliographic metadata (authors, title, venue, year, DOI/URL as supplemental). Ensure each numbered citation in the prose is supported by the referenced primary source; update any citation markers if necessary. This revision may be completed by inserting the full BibTeX/metadata already present in the archived evidence bundle into the manuscript References section.

Condense the Disclosure Statement to a concise paragraph limited to the mandatory items: declared model(s) and provider, adapter/framework names, the immutable initial master prompt locator and its SHA‑256 (exact path as archived), a brief statement of the human Research Director role vs. post‑lock AI autonomy, confirmation that the study was preregistered (identifier present) and that full execution artifacts are archived (execution/* and analysis/* paths referenced). Remove reproduction of execution logs, per‑task counts, provider‑call bookkeeping, or detailed artifact hashes from the disclosed prose (these remain in the archived bundle and must not be duplicated verbatim in the manuscript).
optional_revisions: Add a one‑sentence explicit reminder in Methods/Results that the reported bootstrap percentile CI is exploratory and not part of the preregistered confirmatory procedure (the manuscript already states this; a short clarifying sentence in Methods or Results would reduce misreading).
Shorten figure/table captions and combine or remove nonessential figures to maximize information density if page budget is tight (this is optional unless page count exceeds limits).
